name: xmip
description: Validates a cluster's xmip.toml, its Xmip Applications among its sections, or an Xmip node configuration through the runtime itself, as you edit it; suggests every key and value, looks up definitions and references, creates, renames and deletes entries and fixes what the runtime reports; and designs the cluster's one xmip.toml view by view.

commands.title: Xmip: Open in the cluster designer
Xmip: Add to the cluster's xmip.toml
Xmip: Rename in the cluster's xmip.toml
Xmip: Delete from the cluster's xmip.toml

xmip.server.path.description: The xmip-lsp executable: a name on PATH or a full path. After a cargo build of xmip-core-gui-vscode it is target/debug/xmip-lsp.

xmip.runtime.library.description: The runtime's native library (xmip_core_runtime.dll, .so or .dylib) that validates the configuration. The server finds none on its own: empty means every validation says that no runtime library was named.
